title: Definitely not a good brand for fans
text:
Definitely not a good brand for fans. I've purchased three Honeywell fans in the last few years (at least two different models, but Amazon is rolling my reviews for all models into a single review for some unknown reason), and have yet to have one that didn't start making rattling noises within the first two months. Not just a quiet mechanical rattle, but the kind of rattle that makes you worry that the thing is going to catch on fire at night if you dare to leave it running while you sleep. One of the fans actually completely stopped working within six months of purchase, and the others have been replaced with a different brand that does not appear to suffer from the same low quality issues.

I'd be willing to accept that one fan breaking down so quickly was an anomaly, but the pattern seems pretty consistent. Consistent enough, at any rate, that I will no longer purchase Honeywell fans.
